purpose: Static ArmNN/Alnpu support-boundary audit plus reuse of retained real-graph board results; no new workload or benchmark is claimed.

source_checkout.checkout_status: DIRTY_PREEXISTING_EXTERNAL_CHECKOUT; committed HEAD used for provenance

run_script.backend_note: The executable's default backend string includes Alnpu,CpuAcc,CpuRef; retained strict probes requested -b Alnpu and disabled CPU fallback.

vendor_app_model_result.process_exit_semantics: Vendor application catches the Optimize exception and may return 0; exception text is authoritative.

packaging.board_runtime_identity: The six compared ArmNN/parser/protobuf/timeline objects are byte-identical to the board runtime; no independent NEW runtime was found.

support_dispatch_static_audit.method: readelf -rW/objdump -T/nm/strings on AArch64 libarmnn.so.32.1; no ArmNN backend source was available in the audited SDK/repository scopes

layer_support_dispatch.predicate_interpretation: The vtable slots for the listed methods resolve to LayerSupportBase implementations, whose static code shape and embedded unsupported-reason strings are the generic reject path. Alnpu-specific support is therefore an explicit whitelist of overridden methods, not a blanket quantized-layer capability.

embedded_validation_predicates: weights is not a supported type
biases is not a supported type
the channel of conv input is not lesser or equal to 4095
the height/width of output must be within 1..1023
the pad is not equal to (kernel_size-1)/2
the channel of FC input is not lesser or equal to 2038
alpha is not a supported type
shapes are not suitable for implicit broadcast
support_dispatch_static_audit.scope_limit: Binary strings and dispatch tables reveal the compiled predicates and reasons but do not recover the unavailable backend source or prove support for a dtype/shape not exercised by a real graph.

positive_face.observed: Task 026 Alnpu/ALHardNPU positive; no Split operator

project_yolov5n_uint8.first_real_graph_failure: QAsymmU8 Conv2d, Activation and ElementwiseBinary at Alnpu Optimize

project_yolov5n_int8.first_real_graph_failure: QSymmS8 Conv2d, Activation and ElementwiseBinary at Alnpu Optimize

real_graph_evidence.bisection_scope: Existing parser_bisection.json contains dependency-sliced and full graph-derived probes. Its synthetic QDQ matrix remains explicitly inconclusive and is not used as support proof.

hardware_context.interpretation: 05-5 is a GEG400 SoftNPU configuration with SOFT_YOLO enabled, but this static hardware fact does not imply support for every ArmNN graph/dtype dialect.

conclusion.support_boundary: Alnpu support is an explicit compiled method whitelist; unoverridden Conv2d/Activation/Splitter/elementwise slots use the generic LayerSupportBase rejection path. Observed dtype-specific failures are QAsymmU8 and QSymmS8 on real graphs.
conclusion.face_vs_yolo: The face control loads successfully through three reported Alnpu|ALHardNPU workloads and has no Split; this is a vendor-specific fused/custom path, not generic Conv2d support. YOLOv8n adds eight Split nodes, while YOLOv5n quantized graphs fail earlier on Conv2d/Activation/ElementwiseBinary.
conclusion.runtime_skew: NOT_PROVEN; the available release ArmNN objects are byte-identical to the board runtime.
conclusion.next_minimum_action: Obtain a vendor-supported graph/operator configuration or backend build that exercises the required real quantized layers; do not infer support from synthetic probes or change the board bitstream.
